## What changed

1. **REQUIRED — shared `.bora.toml` root resolution:** Added `Workspace::bora_config_root()` in `src/workspace.rs` (worktree-space parent repo root, else git-space repo root) as the single source of truth. All three copies of the idiom now use it: `AppState::repo_issue_flow_template()` (state.rs, menu-open), `App::prepare_flow_agent_start` (mod.rs, run-time — previously read only `git_space().repo_root`), and the workspace context-menu `.bora.toml` load at mouse.rs:1182. Menu-time and run-time can no longer resolve different templates for linked worktrees.

2. **Silent no-op → toast:** the `git_space` None path in `start_flow_run` now warns and shows a NeedsAttention toast: title "cannot run bora-flow", context "workspace git metadata is not ready yet". Covered by new test `flow_run_without_git_metadata_shows_needs_attention_toast`. (The no-active-workspace path stays a quiet warn-only no-op — a menu can't be opened without one.)

3. **`{repo}` = stable checkout root:** dropped `resolved_identity_cwd_from`; both `{repo}` and the AgentStart `cwd` now use `git_space.repo_root` (worktree-aware, immune to a pane's `cd`), matching the config doc comment.
